text: I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he's 2, and I've lost the leaflet for the medicine. How much paracetamol can I give him, and is it all right to give ibuprofen as well? He's not been himself with a cold. He's wide awake, sat on the settee chatting at the telly, so no worries there. His neck's fine too, I checked and he can look down at his toes no bother. He's got a few red spots on his arms and legs but that's the mosquitoes, we were in the garden all afternoon and I watched them biting him. I'm worn out, I just want to get the dose right and get us both to bed.
